contract: Reviewed against frozen PHP Server 2.5.14, Workflow 2.5.5 and PHP SDK 2.2.6 on the six-configuration PHP/Rust/embedded matrix. Pause skips a manual trigger without starting work; resume triggers one original authored echo workflow. Retain original schedule, trigger, generated workflow/run and audit relationships, exact Avro int64 input and stored completion. Delete after completion; HTTP triggering returns schedule_not_found and admits no new work. Fresh audit history survives deletion and adapter-specific visibility is checked before projection. Frozen embedded resume audit retains its stale zero skip representation while fresh state and subsequent trigger retain the actual skip. Cron/timezones, overlap concurrency, backfill, missed fires, namespace/auth, other client directions and schedule hard-kill recovery remain separate gates.
